lines: 1. Bible khou tuna gaan ruh pari khou sa e;
Gaan pa-nguh rui cham dan, pa-nguh rui cham dan mak,
Chamv daan mei nun rui kaniu maibung khou thao nai
Chamv daan mak meirui karaeng sin bam .
Na guang pu the nkhuan bam o,
Lau khuan ni kalan ganv khou ni cho !
Kandih mei nun rui kaganv tei thai mak ge,
Chariak thai na nkhuanc na bam o.
2. Tunaa gan pa-nguh rui gan pa-nguh khou sa e,
Nang niu thaodui tei aniu khang ni ti lou o,
Migan khou tei tunaa gan pa-nguh rui sa e;
Nang niu tat na zuanc mei thang la tho.
3. Hei khou tei tunaa gan pa-nguh tei tat kan the
Noupou pu tei guangc nga kaikhamv mbang kan the;
Hei khou tei kaniu guang na kaikham nchou the,
Noupou rui kaniu ta thai mak khe.
4. Jisu rui guang dat nimei ganv tei na guang the,
Kamei nun ta lakhang kamei kei dat puni
Hei ganv khou kiu chamvdaan na bam mei kaguai rui
Ting saeng zaeng ring suang mei lapuni.

legacyVerification.note: Transcribed from supplied PDF, printed song number 173. Original spelling and line breaks are kept where text extraction permits.
